name: Pursiainen Aino
original_name: プルシアイネン 藍乃
source:
A half-Finnish and half-Japanese girl. Despite her Scandinavian looks she was born and raised in Japan and can only speak Japanese. [url=/c97352]Misora's[/url] best friend. They make a good pair together.
[Translated from [url=https://twitter.com/gdiv1_5pb/status/1393128372092375048?s=20]the official Memories Off Twitter account.[/url]]
